title: Build archives fail on a private repository: attestations need a public repo
description: actions/attest-build-provenance fails with 'Feature not available for user-owned private repositories' (run 45074661443, x86_64-apple-darwin). While markmals/mcp is private, Build archives and therefore release.yml cannot finish. Decide: make the repo public before the first release, or skip attestation for private repositories (and say so in README).
